intent: Execute the live Migadu GitHub failure routing and autonomous investigation path, recover bounded failures, and persist receipt-grade evidence.

allowed: read Migadu domain and mailbox configuration
create and verify required IMAP folders
upload and activate the named loop-safe Sieve policy
send a bounded synthetic GitHub failure test
create one deduplicated downstream investigation job
retrieve GitHub Actions run, job and log evidence
apply a bounded non-destructive repair when authorised
write receipts and append durable ledger records
comment on issue 237 with receipt locations and final classification
forbidden: destructive GitHub changes without separate authority

real_gate.folder_placement: Synthetic GitHub failure is observed in Systems/GitHub/Failures via IMAP readback.
real_gate.agent_delivery: Exactly one preserved copy is observed in github-agent@tech4humanity.net.
real_gate.job_creation: A downstream investigation job ID and deduplication key are persisted.
real_gate.investigation: GitHub Actions run, job, step and log evidence are captured.
real_gate.repair_or_rerun: A bounded repair is applied when authorised, or an explicit BLOCKED receipt identifies the authority/dependency gap; failed workflow work is rerun when applicable.
real_gate.github_readback: Post-rerun workflow conclusion and commit/check status are read back from GitHub.
real_gate.receipt: A JSON deployment/execution receipt records every gate, evidence path, hashes, timestamps and final state.
real_gate.ledger: The same run is appended to the durable ledger and independently read back.

recovery.missing_credentials: Emit BLOCKED receipt naming only missing variable names, never values; retain job for retry.
recovery.mailbox_or_folder_failure: Retry idempotently, preserve before/after state, and do not delete existing mail or folders.
recovery.sieve_failure: Keep prior active script, record upload/activation response, repair syntax or CLI dependency, then retry.
recovery.routing_test_failure: Capture message identifiers and IMAP listings, diagnose rule matching, patch only the named policy, and rerun one bounded test.
recovery.github_failure: Capture run/job/log evidence; use failed-job rerun where safe; otherwise emit explicit BLOCKED evidence.
recovery.ledger_failure: Do not classify REAL; rebuild or reroute ledger persistence and independently read it back.

completion_rule: Do not close issue 237 and do not classify REAL until every real_gate field has observed evidence and both receipt and ledger have been read back.
